subject: Re: Q2 final bump offer for Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2024 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: $5k trial bump to close Nimbus Health

Team —

Quick background: Nimbus Health (payer pilot for remote monitoring) is at the final procurement stage. They were asking for another week of evaluation and a little more consumption to validate integration. Customer signals are strong but they need a clear, time-limited cost alignment to sign this quarter.

Ask: Can we approve a one-time $5,000 platform credit (applied as consumption credit / billing adjustment) that expires 30 days after activation if they sign the pilot order by 2024-06-30? I put the proposed terms in the attached doc and included the HubSpot snapshot.

Why this is high ROI:
- ACV for initial pilot is $120k ARR if they convert after pilot.
- They commit to a 6-month pilot and product integration plan (see snapshot).
- Close-by date is effectively 6/30 — sales motion is already in legal/IT review.

Attachments: proposed-bump-terms.docx (proposed language), nimbus-ma-snapshot.pdf (deal summary), approval-request-form.pdf

If we can greenlight this, I will send a short, explicit offer to the buyer and attach DocuSign for the pilot order. Happy to adjust terms (smaller credit, commitment tweaks) if needed.

Thanks — Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2024 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: $5k trial bump to close Nimbus Health

Maya —

Thanks for the context. On the surface this makes sense given the pipeline and the conversion potential. I can approve a one-time $5k credit for deals that include the 6-month pilot commitment and an explicit conversion checkpoint (we need that to avoid open-ended credits). Please make sure the credit is clearly noted as promotional and expires 30 days after invoice activation.

Please also include a short clause that the credit is non-transferrable and only usable by Nimbus Health for the specified pilot. Once you have the DocuSign, loop me back and I will sign off formally.

-Marissa
VP, Growth & GTM
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2024 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: $5k trial bump to close Nimbus Health

Maya —

Two quick ops notes: first, billing needs the credit to be coded as "promotional credit - pilot conversion" in our system and tied to the deal_id. Second, finance wants the exact redemption window (30 days after activation is fine) and a short usage cap that matches expected pilot consumption (I'll add the cap to the terms doc).

I can prepare the billing memo once you confirm the final wording; Connor, can you ensure legal is comfortable with the non-transferability language?

-Karthik
Sales Operations
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Barnes <julia@nimhealth.com>
Cc: Kevin Lowe <kevin.lowe@nimhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2024 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline and final offer

Julia —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Quick follow-up with a short, time-bound offer to help you validate throughput and integration before contract commit:

Offer summary (one-time promotional bump)
- $5,000 platform credit applied as consumption credit toward pilot usage
- Credit expires 30 days after pilot activation
- Pilot commitment: 6 months, conversion review at month 4
- Credit applies only to Nimbus Health (non-transferrable) and must be accepted via the pilot order by 2024-06-30 to qualify

I've attached the proposed terms and a short order to sign. If you can confirm by close of business on 6/28 we will push the DocuSign with the credit language included.

Attachments: proposed-bump-terms.docx

If that works, I'll route the signed order and the internal approval memo (per Marissa/Karthik) to billing so the credit is prepped ahead of activation.

Best —
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.ai
From: Julia Barnes <julia@nimhealth.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kevin Lowe <kevin.lowe@nimhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Jun 2024 20:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline and final offer

Maya —

Appreciate the clear offer. Nimbus is willing to accept the $5k credit under the terms you outlined. We're going to push this through procurement tonight and expect to return a signed DocuSign by EOD 6/30.

Please include the billing contact (procure@nimhealth.com) on the DocuSign envelope so we can close the loop on our side.

Looking forward to getting started — Julia Barnes
Director of Digital Health Programs
Nimbus Health
